name: – Michael Gahler – After § 23 – Am 13
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: 23a. Calls for the cancellation of Ukraine’s foreign debt in order to enable a genuine recovery and reconstruction of its society, based on the highest social and environmental standards and to ensure that when the Ukrainian people regain their independence from the Russian aggressor, they will not fall into a new form of economic dependence;
